inputs.title: Server Issue - Windows Authentication Login Issues Following an Authentication Method Change
inputs.content_preview:
| Issue | Changing server authentication type to Windows Authentication can cause Gallery menu to disappear or profile page lacks permission etc. after login. |
| --- | --- |
| Screenshot |  |
| Possible Cause | Existing Gallery user records may contain incomplete identity information after the authentication change. e.g. If the WindowsIdentity field in MongoDB is null, Gallery access may fail. |
| Resolution Overview | Remove the affected user record from MongoDB so it can be automatically re-c

routing.review_reason: New taxonomy node 'authentication' required under 'product-tree/alteryx-server/authentication' — pending taxonomy approval
routing.proposal_rationale: Authentication (SAML, SCIM, SSL/TLS, NTLM, Windows Auth, Built-in Auth) is a broad, self-contained domain with its own errors, configuration, logging, and troubleshooting patterns. An 'authentication' subtree is strongly justified.
